body: I was just banned for ban evading and i was just trying to help out a friend.  What should I do?
body_tagged: I was just banned for ban evading and i was just trying to help out a friend.  What should I do?
title: Appealing an infraction

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

You were banned for evading the ban on JoeThePinapple, who was hacking. So you're saying JoeThePinapple is your friend? If so, then why is he on the same IP as you?

Regards,
Auratix_,
Senior Moderator
